post.summary: Split the task into subtasks with a published workflow
post.description: Runs the workflow's published version over the task (its title and description as input, its project as the run's project) as the caller. When the run succeeds, its output's `tasks` array (items with `title` and an optional `description`) becomes the task's subtasks: pending, unassigned, in the task's project. Writing them and ending the decomposition share one transaction, so a run's subtasks are written once. Any other end fails the decomposition with a reason. Errors: `decomposition_active` (409) while another is running, `invalid_workflow` (400) for a workflow that is missing or unpublished, `task_closed` (409) for a done or cancelled task, `subtask_not_decomposable` (409) for a subtask.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
